label: Rowe's WhollyGood satisfies the constraint-respecting rescue standard (WHOLLY_GOOD_2)
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Every Rowe-wholly-good being permits an occurring preventable event that would be strictly better prevented only when some way of preventing exists and every such way fails a double-effect condition 1-3 (evil object, planned harm, or harm as a MEANS_1).
